themes.name: [Negative] Payment & Account Activation Failures

quotes.text: if you join this app. your payment is stuck ..not suggest to use this app
I was applied on an ipo though this app. But the payment status is not updated waiting several hours.
The account is not being activated even after writing repeatedly and submitting KYC documents.

themes.description: Users repeatedly report that adding funds, withdrawing money, or activating their trading account fails or remains pending, causing frustration.
themes.business_impact: Revenue loss from stalled trades, increased support tickets, higher churn, and potential regulatory risk from failed IPO payment handling.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: Inconsistent integration with payment gateways and delayed KYC verification pipeline, coupled with insufficient error handling in the app and backend causing status updates to remain stale.
themes.action_plan:
• Audit and refactor payment gateway integration
• Implement real‑time status updates and retries
• Re‑engineer KYC verification workflow for faster processing
• Add manual override queue for pending activations
• Deploy monitoring dashboards for payment flows
• Communicate clear ETA to users
• Run regression tests on payment and KYC paths
• Train support on new procedures

themes.name: [Negative] Chart Rendering Failures

quotes.text: Charts have stopped displaying reliably. Why!
today, on 6th August, 2026. I'm try to open the chart but it's give me some error, is this only for me or all the users get the same.
charts stop loading whenever they want.
chart not opening in mobile app, very disappoint

themes.description: Users consistently report that charts fail to load, freeze, or display errors across the app, causing delayed or missing market data when opening or refreshing charts.
themes.business_impact: Real‑time data unavailability forces users to wait or abort trades, eroding confidence and increasing churn, potentially reducing trading volume and revenue.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: The failures likely stem from a combination of memory leaks and inefficient data‑fetching in the chart rendering engine, exacerbated by recent updates that introduced new chart libraries and altered API endpoints.
themes.action_plan:
• Perform root cause analysis by reproducing chart load failures in QA and reviewing network logs
• Identify and fix memory leaks in the chart rendering component, ensuring proper cleanup of canvas objects
• Optimize data fetching: implement caching, reduce data points, and use pagination
• Upgrade chart libraries to the latest stable versions and remove deprecated APIs
• Add robust error handling and retry logic for network failures
• Conduct comprehensive regression testing across Android, iOS, and web platforms
• Deploy incrementally while monitoring chart load times and error rates
• Communicate release notes and improvements to users
